dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll note that arrangement. For today's discussion, let us start with your identification details, then move straight to the account matter.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.text: Thank you. We can turn to what you wished to discuss.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. Please give me the transaction details you would like recorded.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. That concludes our discussion. I've also noted your preference for arranging future telephone appointments by message. Thank you for your time today.
